encoding: ASCII JSON object followed by LF; canonical compact separators; insertion order retained

object.value: tagged scalar or recursively tagged container

numpy: original scalar bytes as hexadecimal, preserving dtype byte order
float64: IEEE754 binary64 network-order 8 bytes as hexadecimal; signed zero and NaN payload retained

unsupported_types: fail closed, never stringify, round, drop, or coerce
timestamp_rule: integer nanoseconds are serialized as integers/NumPy int scalars without floating point conversion
receive_time: application observation time of stable SDK window, not original per-tick wire arrival time
replay: only exact same-source content overlap is suppressed; observations record the decision; all revisions/reset ambiguity retained
compression: independently decodable checksum-enabled Zstandard frames; no dictionary; originals hashed before compression
